@programName: RM Woodworks SecureScan SAMPLE FIXTURE - NOT A LIVE SCAN
sample_notice: Clearly labeled sample data for interface testing only. This is not a real OWASP ZAP scan and must not be presented as genuine assessment evidence.

alerts.name: Remote OS Command Injection
alerts.desc:
The scanner detected a parameter that may be passed to an operating system command.

This is a sample alert used to demonstrate the SecureScan review workflow.
alerts.solution: Avoid passing user-controlled input to shell commands. Use framework APIs or strict allowlists instead.

alerts.name: SQL Injection
alerts.desc:
SQL injection may be possible. The scanner identified that a parameter appears to be incorporated into a SQL statement without sufficient validation.

This is a sample alert used to demonstrate the SecureScan review workflow.

instances.evidence: You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your MySQL server version

alerts.solution: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements for every database query. Validate and whitelist input where appropriate, and avoid concatenating user input into SQL strings.

alerts.name: Cross Site Scripting (Reflected)
alerts.desc:
Reflected cross-site scripting may be possible because user input appears in the response without adequate output encoding.

This is a sample alert used to demonstrate the SecureScan review workflow.
alerts.solution: Encode output contextually and validate input. In Laravel Blade, rely on escaped output with {{ }} and avoid unescaped rendering of user-controlled values.

alerts.name: Missing Anti-clickjacking Header
alerts.desc:
The response does not include an X-Frame-Options header or a suitable Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors directive.

This is a sample alert used to demonstrate the SecureScan review workflow.
alerts.solution: Return an X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN header, or use a Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors directive to control framing.

alerts.name: Cookie No HttpOnly Flag
alerts.desc:
A cookie was set without the HttpOnly flag, which may allow client-side scripts to read it.

This is a sample alert used to demonstrate the SecureScan review workflow.
alerts.solution: Set the HttpOnly flag on session and authentication cookies. Also use Secure and SameSite attributes where appropriate.

alerts.alert: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
alerts.desc:
The response does not include a Content-Security-Policy header. A CSP can reduce the impact of certain injection flaws.

This is a sample alert used to demonstrate the SecureScan review workflow.
alerts.solution: Define a Content-Security-Policy that allows only the sources required by the application, and test it in report-only mode before enforcing it.

alerts.name: Information Disclosure - Debug Error Messages
alerts.desc:
The response appears to contain a framework debug error message. Detailed errors can reveal implementation details to an attacker.

This is a sample alert used to demonstrate the SecureScan review workflow.

instances.evidence: SQLSTATE[42S02]: Base table or view not found

alerts.solution: Disable debug mode in production and return generic error pages to users while logging details server-side.
